title: You Are Always Being Formed
headline: What Is Forming You?
tagline: The question isn’t whether you are being formed. The question is: what is forming you?
seo_title: What Is Forming You? Romans 12:2 and Spiritual Formation | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Something can be culturally normal and spiritually deforming at the same time. A devotional for men on Romans 12:2 and the patterns shaping them.
verse_text: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind….

scriptures.text: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind….
Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

items: Becoming does not happen in a vacuum.
Success and failure have influenced you.
The voices you repeatedly hear influence you.
The things you repeatedly watch influence you.
And increasingly, algorithms participate in deciding what receives your attention.
This does not mean those influences determine who you become.

blocks.text: But formation is happening while we live.

sections.label: There Is a Pattern Trying to Shape You

items: Romans 12:2 says, “Do not conform to the pattern of this world.”
The world does not merely offer individual bad decisions.
And normal can begin feeling true.

blocks.text: Something can be culturally normal and spiritually deforming at the same time.

sections.label: There Is an Unspoken Curriculum Around You

items: Not only through what it says, but through what it rewards.
- What does your friend group reward?
Don’t merely ask, “What am I thinking?” Ask, “What has been training me to think this way?”
Culture can train your eyes before it ever wins an argument with your mind.
The deepest answer to a lesser fascination is not always greater willpower. Sometimes we need a greater vision of Christ.
We behold. The Spirit transforms. We become.
